effectReferenceCorrection.rule: The campus effect reference governs the overall external-road relationship: the four surrounding city roads are straight side streets and must not bend or offset to follow the campus boundary or perimeter wall.
effectReferenceCorrection.perimeterWallRelationship: independent; wall/boundary geometry may vary inside the four straight roads
effectReferenceCorrection.cornerRule: road centerlines remain straight through the side alignment; any curb/intersection corner radius is an edge-treatment detail and must not deform the four centerlines

globalRules.bufferNote: The buffer is a planning target where compatible with the frozen campus boundary; it never authorizes bending a city-road centerline.
